challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: We cannot proceed with the loyalty basket integration until the data contracts are formally signed off. The legal audit has exposed a gap in consent records, and operating without a documented approval puts the entire promotion planning cycle at risk. I will not authorize the pipeline to run on unverified personal data. Until that formal sign off is complete, any forecast relying on loyalty signals is invalid for our business decisions. This is a hard stop. We need the governance layer locked down before we discuss further feature expansion or automation of the consent checks. No exceptions, no temporary workarounds. The integrity of the data foundation is non negotiable.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly defines a hard stop with no exceptions or workarounds, establishing a strict limit that cannot be crossed without formal sign-off.
